turns.text: boss need help before my shift starts. paolo sent me new photos for the lola's roll instagram, he runs it but wants me to pick one for tomorrow's announcement. 3 options: A is a close up of the lumpia on a plate with the dips, B is me at the counter holding a tray, C is a wide shot of the whole counter with a bunch of stuff in it. which one and how do i crop it 🥢

Morning! I can't see the photos, so I'm going on your descriptions. Go with A, the close-up of the lumpia with the dips. Food is what stops a scroll, and a tight shot of the actual product reads clearly even as a tiny thumbnail.

B works as a backup, since people like seeing a face, but the tray may look small in the frame. C sounds too busy to read as 'lumpia' quickly.

Crop for A:
- Use 4:5 portrait (1080x1350). It takes up the most space in the feed.
- Put the lumpia in the center or slightly below the middle, with the dips just inside the edges.
- Trim extra plate or table so the food fills about 70% of the frame.
- Straighten it and bump brightness a little. Don't over-filter it.

If you want, describe A and I'll tell you more specifically what to cut.

ok A it is. now the caption. i want it to reach more than the like 410 people who already follow us lol, so make it something people would share. tell them to come find me at the saturday table at the end of the counter. its $10 for a half dozen

Here's a version built to be shareable:

[Image: close-up of the lumpia on a plate with the dips, cropped to 4:5 portrait with the food filling most of the frame]

Caption:

Crispy, golden, and rolled by hand 🥢🔥
Lola's Roll is out tomorrow. Come find us at the Saturday table at the end of the counter at Heron & Grind.

$10 for a half dozen. Grab some for breakfast, or grab some for the whole group chat.

Tag the friend who'd eat all six. 👇

#lolasroll #lumpia #alcarazflats #filipinofood #localeats

To reach beyond your followers, the 'tag a friend' line and the local hashtags do most of the work. Posting it to Stories too, with a location tag for the cafe, helps more neighbors see it. Want a shorter or punchier version?
ok actually make it friendlier, less salesy. like the way id say it to a regular. and keep the $10 part

Sure, a more conversational one:

[Image: close-up of the lumpia on a plate with the dips, cropped to 4:5 portrait]

Caption:

Hey you 👋 lumpia's back tomorrow!
Come say hi at the Saturday table, end of the counter at Heron & Grind. I'll be there with a fresh batch and the dips.

$10 for a half dozen. Bring a friend, or don't, no judgment if you eat them all yourself 😄

See you there 🥢

The hashtags can go in the first comment if you want the caption itself to feel cleaner. Anything else to tweak before your shift?
perfect sige thanks that helps a ton 🔥
Anytime! Good luck with the batch tomorrow. 🥢
